offer.title: Get Bonus Messages
offer.body: Not ready to sign up? Play a quick game with Luzia for 5 bonus messages.

kpis.primary: Conversion rate from ad-engagement to account signup
kpis.holdout: 5% user-level holdout for 30 days comparing total account creation and engagement rates

storyboard.caption: Guest users encounter a signup wall when accessing features.
Users who dismiss the wall see bonus message options.
The user opts in to a rewarded mini-game.
The user plays the rewarded mini-game with Luzia.
Upon verification, bonus AI usage quota is granted.
